item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang rje 'brug chen po'i gter lugs byams ma byad kyi 'jigs skyobs kyi skor dang / zang zang gi gter ma gtsug gtor gdugs dkar dang*/ khod po blo gros thogs med kyis sba zhabs brag nas gter la thon pa'i gsang sngags gzer bu rnams kyi gzhi byas/ gzhan yang ud 'bar tog gi rgyud la sogs gsang sngags zab gnad che ba rnams kyi rno pa sbyar te/ byad bkrol gyi gdams pa shin tu gsal bar bkod pa/ byad kyi tha ram bkrol ba'i lde mig ces bya ba/ phyi rabs byad gdon gyis nyen pa'i nyams thag rnams la phan pa'i slad du/ rgyal rigs bru yi khri chen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin sku mched zung gi zhal snga nas/ rang re bon lugs la snga sor byad kyi lag len sgrig chog khungs thub cher mi snang stabs/ 'di ltar dgos zhes rten 'brel mi 'gad ('gal) ba'i tshad du/ lha rdzas dri med kyis mtshon gnang rten bzang po dang bcas te/ bka' nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas/ rang nyid kyang lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gnang ba zhus nas/ gsang sngags gab sbas kyi lag len 'phrug sdebs 'di ltar dgos tshul dang / de'i rang gzhan dang bstan 'gror phan thog 'byung ba'i dge mtshan du ma shar bzhin/ sgo rigs kyi drang srong sum ldan rigs pa 'dzin par rlom pa nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal du 'bod pas rje rin po che'i gdan sa bkra shis sman ri'i bla brang du bsgrigs pa/ dge des byad kyi 'jig pa las skyobs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
